## Passages
RESULT [curation]: Removes 50% of LAION with minimal performance loss, which halves training time, and improves out-of-distribution performance. It also beats prior deduplication on C4 for language models.
US [curation]: Harvested Kaggle/Roboflow/HF weed sets are often re-uploads, augmentations or crops of the same few sources (the cwd12 near-copy leak is the extreme case). SemDeDup on box-crop or image embeddings, run across ALL sources before merging, removes the redundancy. The same machinery, pointed at the holdout, is the leak guard. It is cheap enough to run on every increment.
CORRECTION [curation]: Abstract confirms: removes 50% of LAION with minimal loss, halves training time, improves OOD, and improves over prior approaches on C4.
